newsitem.title: USA: Texaco has bought 1.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Texaco has bought 1.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Texaco Inc has spent about $125 million of the $500 million approved in 1995 for stock repurchases, repurchasing about 1.5 million shares of its stock, Chief Executive Peter Bijur said Wednesday.
"We're in a buying mode," said Vice Chairman Allen Krowe, noting the company had repurchased shares as recently as last week.
Texaco is not rushing to spend the remaining $375 million approved last year, Krowe said.
"We're in the market when the price is attractive."
He said the average price the company has paid under the program is "well over 10 percent below" the current market price.
